facts.contactOnly: Check their Instagram for this week’s ramen and yakitori service, private-event closures and current offerings.

panels.head: Ramen and yakitori days
body: Their latest profile and October 29 post list ramen Thursday 5–8pm; yakitori Friday 5–8pm, Saturday 1–7:30pm and Sunday 1–6:30pm. Private events can change the week’s schedule.
Their Japanese market also carries pantry goods and snacks.
